source: Passport issued by VoltCore Cells GmbH, Dresden. Data set version 2.0, last updated 14 January 2026.

fields.label: Product sustainability profile
value: Recycled content (mass balance, FY 2025): cobalt 18.2 %, nickel 7.4 %, lithium 6.1 %, lead 0 %.
Cell assembly powered by 100 % renewable electricity (supplier contract with Guarantees of Origin).
Designed for disassembly and material recovery at end of life.

fields.label: Battery chemistry
fields.value: Lithium-ion — NMC622 cathode | graphite anode | LiPF₆ in EC/EMC liquid electrolyte; 21700 cylindrical cell

fields.label: Impact of substances on environment, human health & safety
value: LiPF₆ forms hydrogen fluoride (HF) on contact with moisture; toxic and corrosive.
Carbonate solvents are flammable; thermal runaway can cause fire and toxic gas release.
Nickel and cobalt compounds are skin sensitisers and suspected carcinogens; avoid dust exposure.
No exposure under normal use while the cell casing remains intact.

fields.label: Bill of materials
value: Positive cap with CID and PTC

fields.label: Carbon footprint as declared (kg CO₂e / kWh of total energy)
Manual for removal of the battery from the appliance
fields.value: Removal guide RM-LIC204 (rev. 1.0): discharge to < 30 % SoC, remove pack cover, disconnect BMS harness, unclip cell holders.

fields.label: Manual for disassembly and dismantling of the battery pack
fields.value: Dismantling guide DM-LIC204 (rev. 1.0): mechanical opening in inert atmosphere; separation of can, electrodes and separator for hydrometallurgical recycling.

fields.label: Postal, e-mail and web address of sources for spare parts
fields.value: VoltCore Service Centre, Industriestraße 14, 01109 Dresden · parts@voltcore-cells.de · https://www.voltcore-cells.de/parts

fields.label: Safety measures / instructions
value: Do not short-circuit, crush, puncture or heat above 60 °C.
Charge only with a BMS-controlled charger within 0–45 °C.
In case of fire use large amounts of water to cool; ventilate (HF risk).
Store at 30–50 % state of charge in a dry place, 15–25 °C.

fields.label: Packaging information
fields.value: Cells in recycled-PET trays (100 per tray), corrugated cardboard outer box; UN 3480 lithium-ion battery marking.

fields.label: Transport modes
value: Air freight only at ≤ 30 % SoC (IATA PI 965)

fields.label: Supplier code of conduct
fields.value: VoltCore Supplier Code of Conduct v2.1 — OECD due-diligence guidance for responsible mineral sourcing, no child or forced labour, third-party audits for cobalt and nickel refiners.

fields.label: Customer-specific requirements
value: Laser-engraved Data Matrix code on each can
PPAP level 3 submission before series supply
